title: Perfect complexes on a scheme with the resolution property are the localization of the homotopy category of finite locally free complexes

standard_prerequisites.name: The perfect complexes form a saturated triangulated subcategory of the derived category, closed under two-out-of-three and direct summands
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the target side of the localization statement.

standard_prerequisites.name: For an exact functor out of a triangulated category, the quasi-isomorphisms in the source form a saturated multiplicative system compatible with the triangulated structure, the localization exists, and the functor factors through it universally
standard_prerequisites.use: Builds the localization S^{-1}K^b(A) and the exact factorization.

standard_prerequisites.name: The resolution property gives: every perfect complex is represented by a bounded complex of finite locally free modules, every map between such complexes in the derived category lifts to an actual map after resolution, and equal maps become homotopic after further resolution
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows the factorized functor is an equivalence.

core_obligations: Observe D_perf(O_X) is a saturated triangulated subcategory of D(O_X) by Cohomology, Lemmas two-out-of-three-perfect and summands-perfect, and K^b(A) is a triangulated category by Derived Categories, Lemma bounded-triangulated-subcategories; the obvious functor sends distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles, i.e., is exact (proof lines 10023-10030).

S, the quasi-isomorphisms in K^b(A), is a saturated multiplicative system compatible with the triangulated structure by Derived Categories, Lemma triangle-functor-localize; hence the localization S^{-1}K^b(A) exists as a triangulated category by Derived Categories, Proposition construct-localization, and the functor factors exactly through it by Derived Categories, Lemma universal-property-localization (proof lines 10030-10042).

By Lemmas resolution-property-perfect-complex, resolution-property-map-perfect-complex, and resolution-property-homotopy-map-perfect-complex, the factorized functor S^{-1}K^b(A) to D_perf(O_X) is an equivalence (proof lines 10043-10052).
Finally the equivalence is one of triangulated categories, in the sense that distinguished triangles correspond, by Derived Categories, Lemma exact-equivalence (proof lines 10052-10057).
proof_roadmap: Check the target subcategory is saturated triangulated and the source functor exact (proof lines 10023-10030).
Construct the localization and the exact factorization via the universal property (proof lines 10030-10042).
Prove the factorized functor is an equivalence by the three resolution property lemmas (proof lines 10043-10052).
Conclude it is an exact equivalence of triangulated categories (proof lines 10052-10057).
